metrics.cancellation_effects: not applicable: hosted inference is one bounded HTTP request with no in-process model load or generation phase to signal, so no cancellation latency exists

metric_definitions.first_result_seconds: client-measured wall time from sending the request to receiving a complete, adaptible structured answer (a structured call list, or a text-only answer); cases with a provider error or an unrepresentable response are named in first_result_missing_cases instead of contributing a latency
metric_definitions.cold_start_seconds: wall time of the first case after provisioning, whose process paid the cold weight page-in
metric_definitions.runtime_reported_load_seconds: llama.cpp load time; per S5 observation it is finalized at the first eval and overlaps the first prefill, so it is not a separate cold-start measure
metric_definitions.prefill: llama.cpp prompt eval tokens over measured prompt eval time; medians across cases
metric_definitions.decode: llama.cpp eval tokens over measured eval time; medians across cases
metric_definitions.process_peak_rss_mib: not measurable: inference is hosted and no model process runs on this host or phone
metric_definitions.process_peak_pss_mib: max sampled PSS from /proc/<pid>/smaps_rollup of that process
metric_definitions.device_mem_available: device MemAvailable from /proc/meminfo, not a process budget
metric_definitions.input_tokens: provider-reported promptTokenCount; unlike the on-device profiles this includes the tool declarations the API renders into the model's own function-calling protocol
metric_definitions.thought_tokens: provider-reported thoughtsTokenCount, recorded separately because thinking exists only in this transport
metric_definitions.request_wall_seconds_median: median client-measured request wall time, including network and provider queueing
metric_definitions.cost_usd_total: sum of provider-reported usage.cost across cases; 0 on the OpenCode Go route means the request counted against the Go plan allowance, and the value is reported only because the provider returned it
metric_definitions.opencode_allowance_usd_total: sum of provider-reported opencode.allowance, the dollars this pass counted toward the Go plan limit

metrics.warm_caveat: cold n=1 per profile; a per-case cold distribution requires page-cache eviction that this phone does not permit

assets.protocol_note: OpenCode Go serves DeepSeek models over the OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API with OpenAI-style tools/tool_calls. Official Console documentation maps deepseek-v4.1-flash to chat/completions; the Responses API is documented for GPT models. The Go gateway route is https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1, distinct from the Console /inference route, whose 402 response is retained only as a wrong-route diagnostic.

preflight.purpose: confirms the Go gateway accepts the frozen tool declarations and generation config

transport.retry_policy: no retry on any 4xx response including 429; at most one retry after a transport timeout or a 5xx response, recorded as attempt 2. A rate-limited case stays a recorded provider error in that pass, and a further complete pass is a separately labelled independent run rather than a retry inside one.
transport.conversation: one user turn, no tool results, no multi-turn follow-up: the same single-turn contract the local profiles were measured under
transport.request_config_revision: v2 — per-provider request blocks; launches paced after an observed free-tier 429; request content, case semantics and adapters unchanged

replay_probe.source: host-constructed bounded idempotency probe; not model output; never scored
